description: Asks before a subagent touches a resource its OpenCode rules ask about; Claude Code ignores subagent hooks of plugins.

hooks.command: R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/claude-agents/agent-guard.mjs"; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$R"; elif command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "$R"; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"agent guard needs node or bun; asking instead"}}'; fi; exit 0
